mainEntity.name: Will restuccoing improve my home's insulation or energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Restuccoing primarily focuses on the exterior finish and protection of your home. While a new layer of traditional stucco can offer a minimal increase in thermal mass, it does not significantly improve insulation or energy efficiency on its own. However, if you opt for a system like EIFS (Exterior Insulation and Finish System), which incorporates an insulation board, then yes, it will substantially enhance your home's insulation and energy performance. We can discuss options based on your specific goals.
acceptedAnswer.description: Traditional restuccoing offers minimal insulation improvement. However, choosing an EIFS system will significantly enhance your home's insulation and energy efficiency.
